> **As of 2026-10-29.** The skills that matter to fleet operations, read from `~/.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md` frontmatter on carbon (10-29 3:2x PM PDT). Several are symlinks into repos: `/dream` and `/vibeloop` -> `~/wintermute/vibecode-kit/skills/`, `/build` -> `~/wintermute/build-skill`, `/self-review` -> `~/wintermute/self-review-skill`, `/pybuild`, `/rustbuild`, `library-skills` (-> `~/dotfiles/.claude/plugins/library-skills`). A model/effort pin in frontmatter holds only for the turn that invokes the skill; the next message runs on the session model (CLAUDE.md § Models and review). Pins and gates are mechanisms, not habits: every pin has a `⚙` pointer in CLAUDE.md. Host presence: only what CLAUDE.md or memory states is marked; everything else is UNVERIFIED because this page was written without ssh to RedBaron/ryzen7. Hook detail lives in [[Fleet Hooks]]; the PRD flow in [[Dream Skill]] and [[PRD Pipeline]].
